agree.reason: A reader who remembers the refunds is likely to be won over by the frank account of the last campaign, the smaller goal, the $36,000 already pledged and the all-or-nothing guarantee, though nothing makes the case for a meaningful pledge from someone who just gave $200 elsewhere.

honest.reason: Every figure and promise traces back to the facts, and the limits on the roof estimate and opening-week films are stated as plainly as they were given, with only a slight lean in 'still selling.'

works_the_facts.reason: It correctly works out the $49,000 still needed but misses the strongest true comparison: the public gave $47,000 last time, nearly the whole remaining gap; it also leaves out the $35,000-lower goal and any per-resident or per-week figure.

right_comparison.reason: The alternative is accurately described as a 38-mile drive for every outing, and the 180 tickets a week shows the demand that went unmet when the cinema closed.

qualification.reason: The all-or-nothing condition has a date, an amount and a consequence, but the roof warning gives no dollar figure and doesn't say what happens to the project or the budget if the cost rises 15%.

objections.reason: The fear of another failure and refund is met head-on, and the roof and distributor caveats come up front, but the reader's recent giving to other local causes is never acknowledged.

fit.reason: It is in the form of a crowdfunding pitch, but at about 360 words it runs slightly over the 350-word limit.
